description: This file is a TypeScript module that acts as a runtime barrel for the Feishu extension, exporting various types, constants, functions, and configurations from the 'openclaw/plugin-sdk' packages. It is used to centralize and re-export core components and utilities related to the Feishu extension runtime.

methods.name: buildChannelConfigSchema
methods.description: Creates a schema for channel configuration.

methods.name: createActionGate
methods.description: Creates an action gate for channel actions.

methods.name: buildProbeChannelStatusSummary
methods.description: Builds a summary of channel status.

methods.name: createDefaultChannelRuntimeState
methods.description: Creates default runtime state for a channel.

methods.name: createChannelPairingController
methods.description: Creates a controller for channel pairing.

methods.name: evaluateSupplementalContextVisibility
methods.description: Evaluates the visibility of supplemental context.

methods.name: resolveChannelContextVisibilityMode
methods.description: Resolves visibility mode for channel context.

methods.name: readJsonFileWithFallback
methods.description: Reads JSON files with fallback options.

methods.name: isRequestBodyLimitError
methods.description: Checks if an error is a request body limit error.

methods.name: readRequestBodyWithLimit
methods.description: Reads the request body with size limit.

methods.name: requestBodyErrorToText
methods.description: Converts request body errors to textual descriptions.
